metadata.checks: Kulador: 2.9 km from the San Andres centroid (CWD: 2.7 km). Caramayon OSM hamlet falls inside Libas (CWD: Sitio Caramayon, Barangay Libas); 3.8 km straight line to Kulador (CWD: 4.65 km pipeline). Cawayan centroid is 4.2 km from the CWD office (CWD: Masacpasac about 4.5 km from the city proper). Office node falls inside Poblacion 4 (CWD: Brgy. 04).
metadata.note: The water system in the model stays SIMULATED. These markers show where the real facilities are, for orientation and for the CWD consultation; they do not drive the model.

properties.name: Kulador Treatment Plant
properties.basis: CWD published coordinate 11°48'44.4" N, 124°54'10.3" E (the site prints 110 and 240; 24° is a typo for 124°).
facts: Takes Antiao River water over a spillway 16 m wide and 1 m tall
Sedimentation box → rapid sand filter → slow sand filter → chlorination; backwash tank
Current discharge about 20 L/s; two transmission lines (6" CI and 8" GI)
Also receives the Caramayon spring water by gravity (10" pipe)
Turned over by the municipal waterworks in 1979, when the water district was created

properties.name: Caramayon Spring and Pumping Station
properties.basis: OSM hamlet "Caramayon" (inside Barangay Libas). The station is in this sitio; its exact position is not published.
facts: Mini dam and sump tank; three high-pressure submersible pumps, 91 L/s combined (CWD: enough for about 9,000 households)
Pumps to a break-pressure chamber, then gravity to Kulador through a 10" pipe (4.65 km)
13.2 kV power line (11.9 km) with a standby generator
Used when Masacpasac and Kulador flows are low (below 10 L/s)
Built 2002–2005 (ADB loan through LWUA's Small Towns Water Supply project); spring at 84.7 m elevation, reachable only on foot

properties.name: Masacpasac Sub-surface Channel
properties.basis: Centroid of Barangay Cawayan (the CWD writes "Kawayan"). The exact site is not published.
facts: Main source together with Kulador; about 20 L/s in the dry season to 40 L/s in the wet season
Sub-surface channel about 50 m long, 8 m wide and 2.2 m deep, at 155 m elevation
Discovered by the Americans in 1945; the 1979 system had an intake box, sand filters and a 9.66 km transmission line

properties.name: Catbalogan Water District office
properties.basis: OSM water-utility node at Allen Avenue Extension, Barangay 4 (matches the CWD address: Pier II, Allen Avenue Ext, Brgy. 04).
facts: Water district created 1978 (Sangguniang Bayan Resolution No. 66 under P.D. 198)
LWUA Conditional Certificate of Conformance No. 107, 7 Dec 1979
